method.3faa0f1d73e9.source: 当前：单头模仿真 · 独立头模验证另列阶段
method.3faa0f1d73e9.en: Current: single-head simulation · Independent-head validation is a separate stage

method.0333aef838e3.source: 查看使用流程、指标定义和计算方法。当前仿真、历史实验与后续验证计划分别列出。
method.0333aef838e3.en: Review the workflow, metric definitions, and computational methods. Current simulations, historical experiments, and future validation plans are listed separately.

method.ee90852ee526.source: 保留率到底是什么？查看公式、示例与AR判断 ↓
method.ee90852ee526.en: What does retention mean? See formulas, examples, and Minimum Required Retention decisions ↓

method.acf1407b2cfd.source: 打开“已有结果”，比较1、2、3、4、6个电极分布区域。选择一行查看已计算点位；“布局设计”用于设置新条件，也可直接进入。查看、筛选和调整AR不会启动新计算。
method.acf1407b2cfd.en: Open Results to compare electrode layouts with 1, 2, 3, 4, or 6 regions. Select a row to view its computed positions. Open Layout Design to set new conditions; you can also enter that page directly. Viewing, filtering, and changing Minimum Required Retention do not start a new computation.

method.7c592ecdf6d8.en: The total is always 64: 64 in 1 region; 32+32 in 2 regions; 22+21+21 in 3 regions; 16×4 in 4 regions; and 11+11+11+11+10+10 in 6 regions. Rotating the 3D view changes the viewpoint, not the electrode positions.

method.389eddb7a9e7.source: 3. 面积和半径是同一个限制吗？
method.389eddb7a9e7.en: 3. Are area and radius the same constraint?

method.b03dfb489444.source: 首页比较所有区域合计的面积上限；按需设计控制每个区域的半径上限。实际面积和半径还受位置与区域分离要求影响。两种实验分开比较，从面积方案新建半径方案时重新评价。
method.b03dfb489444.en: The home page compares limits on the combined area of all regions. On-demand design controls the radius limit of each region. Actual area and radius also depend on position and region-separation constraints. The two experiment types are compared separately; creating a radius-constrained design from an area-constrained layout requires a new evaluation.

method.5eacd6114cbd.source: 4. 与什么比较，三个百分比是什么意思？
method.5eacd6114cbd.en: 4. What is the reference, and what do the three percentages mean?

method.a0d9c134cb23.source: 同一协议下的标准全头64导作为相对基准。信号重建衡量恢复全头信号的能力；幅度保留率（最差10%）取相对损失最大的10%源面积权重的幅度比；相对定位评分由误差换算。三者分别报告。下方完整版给出公式和固定示例。
method.a0d9c134cb23.en: The standard whole-head 64-channel layout under the same protocol is the relative reference. Signal reconstruction measures recovery of the whole-head signal. Amplitude retention (worst 10%) summarizes amplitude ratios for sources with the greatest relative losses, totaling 10% of the source-area weight. The Relative Localization Utility is derived from localization error. All three are reported separately. The full guide below provides formulas and a fixed example.

method.e7a11868d25b.en: 5. How is Minimum Required Retention used?

method.1eebe6f523b9.source: 已有结果和布局设计按三项指标分别不低于AR判断，G为三项最低值。“方案对比”默认只对重建设置AR，也可分别启用幅度、定位评分或毫米误差上限。修改阈值只重新判断已有数值，不改变点位、不重新计算。
method.1eebe6f523b9.en: Results and Layout Design require each of the three metrics to meet Minimum Required Retention; G is their minimum. Compare Layouts applies Minimum Required Retention to reconstruction by default, with optional amplitude, localization-score, and error-in-mm requirements. Changing a threshold only reassesses existing values; it does not move electrodes or rerun the computation.

method.4b9ffc2b7e52.en: 6. How do I run a signal simulation?

method.16602be90893.source: 先选一个已计算的完整布局，再进入“信号仿真”，设置脑源位置、波形和模拟干扰。布局坐标固定；此页只比较所选场景的波形与信号重建，使用当前场景的重建指标判定AR。
method.16602be90893.en: Select a complete, computed layout, then open Signal Simulation and set the brain-source position, waveform, and simulated interference. Layout coordinates remain fixed. This page compares waveforms and signal reconstruction for the selected scenario and applies Minimum Required Retention to that scenario's reconstruction metric.

method.e00736474502.en: 7. How are results saved and retrieved?

method.659a4b5fbc57.source: 计算记录统一保存已有实验与后来计算的结果；相同配置优先直接读取。当前默认手动计算，结果自动保存。各记录注明头模、候选位置和实验协议。不同协议分别查看，独立头模验证另列阶段。
method.659a4b5fbc57.en: Records brings together existing experiments and subsequent results. Matching configurations are loaded before starting new calculations. Computation is manual by default, and results are saved automatically. Each record identifies the head model, candidate positions, and experimental protocol. View different protocols separately; independent-head validation is a separate stage.

method.2b5ad89cd9d1.source: “允许布置范围”直接平铺选择：首页列出已有面积对比与19个预设组合；布局设计中，每个区域都可从9个部位选择，不限于预设。顺序对应各区电极数，可重复选择同一部位，但仍需满足完整布局与区域分离要求。选择部位本身不自动启动计算，除非另行开启自动计算。
method.2b5ad89cd9d1.en: Allowed Placement Range provides direct choices. The home page lists existing area comparisons and 19 preset combinations. In Layout Design, each region can use any of 9 locations, beyond the presets. Their order determines electrode allocation. A location can be selected more than once, subject to complete-layout and region-separation requirements. Selecting a location starts computation only when automatic computation is enabled.

method.d524c1e9d617.source: “区域”指头表面的电极布置范围；“脑源位置”指模拟活动所在的皮层位置。“布局”指64个电极的具体坐标；“配置”指区域数、位置限制和尺寸等输入条件；“记录”是一次保存的结果或搜索状态。
method.d524c1e9d617.en: A region is an electrode-placement area on the head surface. A brain-source position is the cortical location of simulated activity. A layout is the set of coordinates of all 64 electrodes. A configuration comprises inputs such as region count, allowed locations, and size constraints. A record is a saved result or search status.

method.ab567af3e703.source: 当前候选表面经过三组固定方向的外部曝光筛选（128、256、旋转后的128方向）：每组至少有一条无遮挡射线才准入。筛选覆盖区域中心、电极、表面路径和面积面片，排除被外层表面完全遮挡的内部点。它定义几何视线可达范围，尚不包含人工解剖标注或电极贴附验证。
method.ab567af3e703.en: The current candidate surface passes external-exposure screening with three fixed direction sets: 128, 256, and 128 rotated directions. Admission requires at least one unobstructed ray in each set. Screening applies to region centers, electrodes, surface paths, and area patches, excluding internal points completely occluded by the outer surface. This defines geometric line-of-sight accessibility; manual anatomical annotation and electrode-attachment validation are not included.

method.51f3da3dff14.source: 三维彩色面片使用计算中保存的原生顶点集合，每个顶点占相邻三角形面积的三分之一；这与报告的面积积分一致。每区按钮显示电极数与实际面积，并将视角转到该区域。原坐标范围的面积结果保留在“历史面积实验”，新搜索不沿用旧坐标的分数。
method.51f3da3dff14.en: Colored 3D patches use the native vertex sets saved by the computation. Each vertex receives one third of each adjacent triangle's area, matching the reported area integral. Each region button shows its electrode count and actual area and turns the view toward that region. Results for the original coordinate domain remain in Historical Area Experiments; new searches do not reuse scores for the old coordinates.

method.7e2949226202.source: 三项指标为“信号重建保留率”“幅度保留率（最差10%）”和“相对定位评分”。G取三者最低值，用于与接受阈值AR比较。
method.7e2949226202.en: The three metrics are Field Reconstruction Retention, Amplitude Retention (Worst 10%), and Relative Localization Utility. G is their minimum and is compared with Minimum Required Retention.

method.cbf3ea226652.source: 少毛发候选区按模型坐标近似划定，毛发分布尚待解剖审核。耳后邻近区为近耳后外侧范围，耳周扩展区覆盖更大范围，眶周上外侧为眼眶上外侧近似范围。
method.cbf3ea226652.en: The low-hair candidate domain is approximated using model coordinates; hair distribution still requires anatomical review. The near-postauricular region lies near the outer area behind the ear, the expanded periauricular region covers a larger area, and the superolateral periorbital region approximates the upper outer orbital area.

method.b802c1f4eccb.source: 方案对比、坐标导入与位置偏移
method.b802c1f4eccb.en: Design comparison, coordinate import, and position shifts

method.78af96cd7819.source: 从“已有结果”的所选布局进入“加入方案对比”，或在主导航打开“方案对比”。选择A、B后先核对协议、实际面积与允许位置范围，再设置接受条件。可导出Markdown报告、完整JSON及64点CSV坐标。
method.78af96cd7819.en: Choose Add to Compare Layouts for a selected layout in Results, or open Compare Layouts from the main navigation. After selecting A and B, check their protocols, actual areas, and allowed locations before setting acceptance requirements. Export a Markdown report, complete JSON, or CSV coordinates for all 64 points.

method.24c1fcfd06e7.source: 坐标导入限定为已经配准到本项目Ernie头模的原生毫米坐标；X向右、Y向前、Z向上。模板明确记录坐标系、单位、64个点和从0开始的区域标签。其他头模、MNI或数字化仪坐标需先配准。三维预览只显示输入，不产生性能评分。
method.24c1fcfd06e7.en: Imported coordinates must already be registered to this project's native Ernie head-model frame in mm: X points right, Y anterior, and Z superior. The template specifies the coordinate frame, units, 64 points, and zero-based region labels. Coordinates from other head models, MNI space, or digitizers require registration first. The 3D preview displays the input without generating performance scores.

method.4d29baf2b5e6.source: 点击“评价当前坐标”后，候选库内的点复用相应FEM场。新点投影到原头表面，最大调整距离限制为2 mm；最小直线点距为4 mm。新位置通过FEM直接求解，同时重新计算标准64参照，核对其与原前向库的一致性。结果保存实际评价坐标，三维图可切换原始输入和实际评价位置。
method.4d29baf2b5e6.en: After Evaluate Current Coordinates is selected, points in the candidate bank reuse their FEM fields. New points are projected onto the original head surface with an adjustment limit of 2 mm and a minimum straight-line spacing of 4 mm. FEM fields are solved directly at new positions, while the standard-64 reference is recomputed and checked against the original forward bank. Results retain the actual evaluated coordinates; the 3D view can switch between original inputs and evaluated positions.

method.8baa0ea374c0.source: 网格偏移测试只使用已有FEM候选点。对每个区域生成一个目标平移方向，在3、6或10 mm位移上限内匹配64个互异的候选点；4次确定种子的试验不依据性能重抽样。匹配后的实际位移、目标误差、未移动比例及点距分别报告；点距失败的试验保留坐标和原因，不给出分数。原区域标签保留，贴片边界与连通性不重新认证。
method.8baa0ea374c0.en: The grid-shift test uses only existing FEM candidate points. A target translation direction is generated for each region, then 64 distinct candidate points are matched within a 3, 6, or 10 mm displacement limit. The 4 deterministically seeded trials are not resampled based on performance. Actual displacement, target error, unchanged-point fraction, and spacing are reported separately. Trials that fail spacing requirements retain coordinates and reasons but receive no scores. Original region labels are retained; patch boundaries and connectivity are not recertified.

method.1e6e41382157.source: 重新标定：使用Hδ对应的LMMSE估计器。
method.1e6e41382157.en: Recalibration: use the LMMSE estimator corresponding to Hδ.

method.dfd473dfb224.source: 沿用原标定：将H₀对应的固定估计器作用于yδ。
method.dfd473dfb224.en: Original calibration: apply the fixed estimator corresponding to H₀ to yδ.

method.3f7f9637f979.source: 两者均以标准64干净场为目标，物理噪声尺度保持不变。
method.3f7f9637f979.en: Both target the clean standard-64 field and retain the same physical noise scale.

method.016a814a7c73.source: 这些重建分数由给定源协方差的期望误差计算，不是有限训练样本下的实测结果。固定估计器的解释率可为负值，表示其误差超过输出零信号的基准。定位使用4096点字典、256个离字典生成源及每源16次噪声，新评价采用配对噪声，与原记录评分分开显示。
method.016a814a7c73.en: These reconstruction scores are calculated from expected error under the specified source covariance, rather than measured from finite training samples. The fixed estimator's explained-energy score can be negative, indicating greater error than a zero-signal prediction. Localization uses a 4096-point dictionary, 256 off-dictionary generation sources, and 16 noise realizations per source. New evaluations use paired noise and are displayed separately from the original record's scores.

method.75ac5058df12.source: 本地布局搜索、源信号仿真和坐标评价共用一个计算工作槽。原布局搜索与原多源模式最多2线程；新单源、新坐标接收和坐标评价单线程。新坐标相关任务上限10分钟，支持停止和相同输入缓存复用。独立头模迁移、实测噪声校准和实体采集对照列为下一验证阶段。
method.75ac5058df12.en: Local layout search, source-signal simulation, and coordinate evaluation share one worker slot. The original layout search and multi-source mode use at most 2 threads. New single-source simulations, reception at new coordinates, and coordinate evaluation use one thread. Tasks involving new coordinates have a 10-minute limit, support cancellation, and reuse cached results for identical inputs. Transfer to independent head models, empirical noise calibration, and physical recording comparisons form the next validation stage.

method.f604487539b4.source: 源—场交互与可复现实验

method.06951372edc6.source: “计算记录”提供初始化、已接受的位置交换曲线及最终布局。搜索目标沿用原实验定义；曲线不包含未保存的被拒绝提案。完整实验包包含原始记录、配置、轨迹和SHA256身份，重新运行需要对应代码版本、头模与前向矩阵。
method.06951372edc6.en: Records provides initialization, the trajectory of accepted position exchanges, and the final layout. Search objectives retain their original experimental definitions; trajectories exclude rejected proposals that were not saved. The complete experiment bundle contains the original record, configuration, trajectory, and SHA256 identities. Reproduction requires the corresponding code version, head model, and forward matrices.

method.337f086be5cb.source: “信号仿真”默认保留区域内6源场景。新增“固定法向单源探索”，从256个冻结生成源中选择一个。它们与4096点反演字典不同；坐标和皮层法向使用原前向模型记录，方向不随界面操作改变。重建器始终由原全脑源先验确定，不用所选测试源重新训练。
method.337f086be5cb.en: Signal Simulation retains the within-region 6-source scenario by default. Fixed-Normal Single-Source Exploration selects one of 256 frozen generation sources. These differ from the 4096-point inverse dictionary. Coordinates and cortical normals come from the original forward-model records; interface actions do not change source orientation. The reconstructor always uses the original whole-brain source prior and is not retrained on the selected test source.

method.a56b6523dc8c.source: 接收仿真固定使用所选记录的原坐标，不执行新布局优化或表面准入审核。列表中的“历史布局”沿用原坐标协议，其结果不归入当前表面筛选下的布局比较；原记录及原多源分析继续可读。
method.a56b6523dc8c.en: Reception simulation uses the selected record's original coordinates, without new layout optimization or surface-admission checks. Historical Layouts in the list retain their original coordinate protocol and are excluded from comparisons under the current surface screening. Original records and multi-source analyses remain readable.

method.3bde3adee517.source: 接收电位采用各布局64通道平均参考。两侧的电极颜色表示这一参考定义下实际坐标处的电位，单位μV；蓝为负、红为正，两侧及全部预览时间共用同一色标。接收图使用各自坐标；重建图和残差图均使用标准64平均参考目标场。点间不插值。黄色标记显示真实源位置，原始法向箭头只在记录包含方向时显示。
method.3bde3adee517.en: Received potentials use a separate 64-channel average reference for each layout. Electrode colors show potentials in μV at the actual coordinates under that reference: blue is negative and red positive. Both layouts and all preview times share one color scale. Reception maps use each layout's own coordinates; reconstruction and residual maps use the average-referenced standard-64 target field. Values are not interpolated between points. Yellow markers show the true simulated source positions; original-normal arrows appear only when orientations are present in the record.

method.f3c390a190a3.source: 拖动时间或播放更新同一时刻的电位；点击电极选择通道，点击源选择源波形。动画读取抗混叠降采样后的50Hz、8秒预览，正式评分始终来自200Hz、20秒完整模拟。它展示准静态电位，不表示信号沿头皮传播。
method.f3c390a190a3.en: Dragging the time control or playing updates potentials at the same time point. Click an electrode to select a channel or a source to select its waveform. Animation uses an anti-aliased 50Hz, 8-second preview; scores always use the complete 200Hz, 20-second simulation. It displays quasi-static potentials, not propagation along the scalp.

method.e59de2ba5ff0.source: “方案对比”中的坐标评价完成后，可进入源—接收仿真。新坐标使用已保存的实际评价坐标，首次运行直接求解FEM并归档64×4352前向矩阵。后续源场景复用该矩阵，源或干扰改变时只重算信号。原多源缓存、新源场景缓存与新坐标前向缓存分别保存。
method.e59de2ba5ff0.en: After coordinate evaluation in Compare Layouts, open source–reception simulation. New-coordinate simulations use the saved evaluated positions. The first run directly solves FEM and archives the 64×4352 forward matrix. Subsequent source scenarios reuse that matrix; changing sources or interference recomputes only the signals. Original multi-source results, new source scenarios, and new-coordinate forward matrices have separate caches.

method.6009b8390786.source: 。本项目保持固定64电极的空间集中研究及原指标定义，未移植这两个项目的优化目标或程序代码。
method.6009b8390786.en: . This project retains its focus on spatial concentration of 64 electrodes and its original metric definitions. Neither project's optimization objectives nor code were ported.

method.ee7491f205ac.source: 按需计算：调整参数后发生什么
method.ee7491f205ac.en: On-demand computation: what happens after parameters change

method.dcb6a2baea82.source: 设计页通过同源接口调用计算服务上的Python程序。固定64点、最小电极直线间距4 mm，标准64导名义SNR＝20 dB， 原始前向库包含5,387个候选位置；当前外部曝光筛选保留其中4,847个。修改半径或区域后，在筛选后的范围内重新搜索，复用对应原坐标的FEM前向场。
method.dcb6a2baea82.en: The design page invokes Python on the computation service through a same-origin interface. It fixes 64 points, a minimum straight-line electrode spacing of 4 mm, and a nominal standard-64 SNR of 20 dB. The original forward bank contains 5,387 candidate positions; current external-exposure screening retains 4,847. Changing radius or regions starts a new search within the screened domain, reusing FEM forward fields at the corresponding original coordinates.

method.3043b8e61721.source: 新版搜索在候选中心组合规模不超过256组时检查全部组合；更大规模保留最多16组的有界筛选。 每组先检查候选点数量，再进行2次布局初始化，最终进行1轮64点坐标交换，每点最多12个提案。 搜索覆盖上述候选中心与区内提案，连续空间的全局最优性和不可行性仍待验证。 优化目标预先固定为信号重建与幅度保留率（最差10%）中的较低值；冻结点位后再计算源定位。 字典为4,096个源，定位使用原有256个离字典源、每源16次噪声；512个新源的复评属于另一批次。
method.3043b8e61721.en: The updated search checks all candidate-center combinations when there are at most 256. For larger sets, bounded screening retains at most 16 combinations. Each combination first checks candidate counts, then uses 2 layout initializations and one round of exchanges across all 64 points, with at most 12 proposals per point. Search covers these centers and within-region proposals; continuous-space global optimality and infeasibility remain unverified. The objective is fixed in advance as the lower of signal reconstruction and amplitude retention (worst 10%); localization is evaluated only after positions are frozen. The dictionary has 4,096 sources. Localization uses the original 256 off-dictionary sources and 16 noise realizations per source. Reevaluation with 512 new sources belongs to a separate batch.

method.c81aa49d91f1.source: 区域采用ROI约束的表面边图路径，要求在原头表面邻接图上形成恰好R个不接触的连通分量。 滑块设置的是共同半径上限；遇区域连接时缩小实际半径，同时报告实际半径和面积。 耳后邻近区、少毛发候选区等范围采用坐标掩膜，解剖审查另列阶段。
method.c81aa49d91f1.en: Regions use ROI-constrained paths on the surface-edge graph and must form exactly R non-touching connected components on the original head-surface adjacency graph. The slider sets a common radius limit; actual radii shrink when regions would connect. Actual radius and area are both reported. Near-postauricular and low-hair candidate domains use coordinate masks; anatomical review is a separate stage.

method.3eb2037c32c2.source: 一次只运行一个任务、使用2线程，180秒超时停止。相同参数、科学代码及前向数据身份的结果可从缓存读取； 修改AR只更新三项阈值判断。G达到AR表示本记录三项相对指标均达到用户阈值。 计算服务未启动时显示未连接；网页从不使用访问者电脑的计算资源。
method.3eb2037c32c2.en: One task runs at a time using 2 threads and stops after a 180-second timeout. Results with matching parameters, scientific-code identity, and forward-data identity can be loaded from the cache. Changing Minimum Required Retention updates only the three threshold decisions. G meets the requirement when all three relative metrics in the record meet the user's threshold. If the computation service is not running, the interface shows it as disconnected. The website never uses the computing resources of a visitor's computer.

method.598bff711777.source: 数据读取优先于计算。关闭自动计算后仍查找缓存，命中时直接恢复坐标和分数；无匹配记录才按需启动Python。 完成或有限搜索未构造出布局的结果保存在计算服务的结果文件中，服务重启后继续使用，不因修改AR失效。 取消、失败和超时仅保存任务日志，不作为性能缓存。输入文件变动时重新校验模型与数据版本。 搜索算法更新后，旧记录仍可查看，也可只恢复其原始参数；设计页读取当前版本的匹配结果。
method.598bff711777.en: Existing data are loaded before computation. Cache lookup continues when automatic computation is disabled; a hit restores coordinates and scores directly. Python runs on demand only when no matching record exists. Completed results and bounded-search outcomes with no constructed layout are stored in the computation service's result files, survive service restarts, and remain valid when Minimum Required Retention changes. Cancelled, failed, and timed-out tasks retain logs only, not performance-cache entries. Input changes trigger model and data-version checks. After search-algorithm updates, old records remain viewable and their original parameters can be restored; the design page loads results matching the current version.

method.e5c8af7a587e.source: “计算记录”页只读展示已有严格面积和半径方案；342个早期半径布局通过历史筛选查看。 总面积上限数据采用原4096点字典与256个生成源；早期半径布局允许区域相交。 历史记录保留其原始协议；当前半径计算按自身版本查找匹配数据。不同协议分别绘制曲线。
method.e5c8af7a587e.en: Records provides read-only access to existing strict-area and radius-constrained layouts. The historical filter exposes 342 early radius layouts. Total-area-limit data use the original 4096-point dictionary and 256 generation sources; early radius layouts allow overlapping regions. Historical records retain their original protocols, while current radius computations retrieve data matching their own version. Curves for different protocols are plotted separately.

method.62a5accd606b.source: 历史结果页 · 原半径实验（允许区域相交）
method.62a5accd606b.en: Historical results · Original radius experiment (overlapping regions allowed)

method.13f47bdbd53b.source: 同样64个点，只改变空间布局
method.13f47bdbd53b.en: The same 64 points, with different spatial layouts

method.b0ba6b7d17f3.source: 1、2、3、4、6区分别分配64；32+32；22+21+21；16×4；11+11+11+11+10+10个测量点。每种区域数均有全头自由中心和低毛发近似约束，另加7种指定耳后／前额／眶周组合，共17个实验族。6种半径上限（20、30、40、50、65、80 mm）乘2种最小电极直线间距（4、6 mm），共204个条件。
method.b0ba6b7d17f3.en: Layouts with 1, 2, 3, 4, or 6 regions allocate 64; 32+32; 22+21+21; 16×4; or 11+11+11+11+10+10 measurement points, respectively. Each region count includes free centers over the whole head and an approximate low-hair constraint. Seven additional postauricular/forehead/periorbital combinations yield 17 experiment families. Six radius limits (20, 30, 40, 50, 65, 80 mm) and two minimum straight-line electrode spacings (4, 6 mm) yield 204 conditions.

method.9b7d85e81e52.source: ① 候选位置上直接求解的FEM前向场
method.9b7d85e81e52.en: ① FEM forward fields solved directly at candidate positions

method.b48be047e693.source: 在Ernie实际头表面生成5,387个候选点，对每一点直接计算体积FEM lead field。采用同一4,096个面积加权皮层法向源和全头基准，候选位置独立于BioSemi64原始点。半径为网格边图最短路径上限；点距是欧氏弦距；面积是连通顶点掩膜的分摊近似。这些几何量采用离散表面近似。
method.b48be047e693.en: A total of 5,387 candidate points are generated on Ernie's head surface, with volumetric FEM lead fields solved directly at every point. All use the same 4,096 area-weighted cortical-normal sources and whole-head reference. Candidate positions are independent of the original BioSemi64 points. Radius is an upper bound on shortest paths along the mesh-edge graph; spacing is Euclidean chord distance; area uses an apportioned approximation over connected vertex masks. These geometric quantities use discrete surface approximations.

method.bcf3ada09768.source: ② 有记录的中心与电极坐标搜索
method.bcf3ada09768.en: ② Recorded search over centers and electrode coordinates

method.701719490e4f.source: 每条件最多24组中心、每组4次几何起点。按20 dB信号重建及min(信号重建,敏感度)分别保留2个起点，每起点进行2轮逐电极交换，每次最多16个候选。再尝试1轮中心交换、每区最多4个中心提案。中心移动必须保留当前点的区域成员资格，之后额外扫描该区域。记录全部接受移动、直接重评分及几何约束；较大半径使用重新核验的小半径结果作为起点。
method.701719490e4f.en: Each condition tests at most 24 center sets with 4 geometric initializations per set. Two starting layouts are retained separately for 20 dB signal reconstruction and min(signal reconstruction, sensitivity). Each undergoes 2 rounds of electrode-wise exchanges with at most 16 candidates per exchange. One round of center exchanges then tests at most 4 center proposals per region. Center moves must preserve current points' region membership, followed by an additional scan of that region. All accepted moves, direct rescoring, and geometric constraints are recorded. Larger radii use revalidated smaller-radius results as starting layouts.

method.482157a81ee7.source: 结果为当前候选网格和预算内找到的较优布局。未构造成功的条件保留尝试次数和已放置点数，其几何可行性仍待判定。
method.482157a81ee7.en: Results are the better layouts found within the current candidate grid and search budget. Conditions without a complete layout retain attempt counts and numbers of placed points; their geometric feasibility remains undetermined.

method.75cb28281d61.source: ③ 对所有最终布局统一评价
method.75cb28281d61.en: ③ Consistent evaluation of all final layouts

method.0fed176c61de.source: 两个分支的最终布局都报告0/10/20 dB的信号重建、敏感度和定位。相同物理通道噪声由全头基准标定，各布局保持同一物理噪声尺度。定位使用256个离字典生成源、每源16次噪声、4,096点固定法向ML字典。每布局每档位进行4,096次模拟试验。定位不参与逐坐标优化，只在最终候选中用于结果比较。
method.0fed176c61de.en: Final layouts from both branches report signal reconstruction, sensitivity, and localization at 0/10/20 dB. Physical channel noise is calibrated using the whole-head reference, with the same physical noise scale for every layout. Localization uses 256 off-dictionary generation sources, 16 noise realizations per source, and a 4,096-point fixed-normal ML dictionary: 4,096 simulated trials per layout per noise condition. Localization does not guide coordinate-wise optimization; it is used to compare final candidates.

method.acc838faab8a.source: 各布局共享噪声分布，但采用独立的固定种子噪声实现，定位比值保留蒙特卡洛波动。生成与反演仍共用解剖和导电率；4096点字典的离散、方向及空间歧义导致模型内非零误差底限。
method.acc838faab8a.en: Layouts share the same noise distribution but use independent, fixed-seed realizations, so localization ratios retain Monte Carlo variability. Generation and inversion share anatomy and conductivity. Discretization, orientation, and spatial ambiguities in the 4096-point dictionary create a nonzero error floor within the model.

method.70f6db13c6c2.source: ④ 模型内阈值判断与独立验证分开
method.70f6db13c6c2.en: ④ Model-conditional threshold decisions and independent validation are separate

method.7bd3008aaeb6.source: 单次定位评分u先对每源16次噪声取均值，再按生成源面积取最低10%的加权均值，得到下尾评分U；相对定位评分Rloc为候选布局U除以标准64导U。基准U为零或非有限数时，Rloc和G保持未定义。三项相对指标分别报告，G用于联合达标判定；每个SNR档位独立判断。
method.7bd3008aaeb6.en: Trial-level localization utility u is first averaged over 16 noise realizations per source. The area-weighted mean over the lowest 10% of generation-source area gives the lower-tail utility U. Relative Localization Utility Rloc is candidate U divided by standard-64 U. If reference U is zero or nonfinite, Rloc and G remain undefined. The three relative metrics are reported separately; G supports their joint threshold decision. Each SNR condition is assessed separately.

method.7ef2f3fbe044.source: 阶段一评价单头模中的布局表现。阶段二计划冻结入围布局，开展独立头模、源先验与模型失配验证。群体置信界评价尚待实施。
method.7ef2f3fbe044.en: Stage one evaluates layouts within a single head model. Stage two will freeze shortlisted layouts and validate them across independent head models, source priors, and model mismatch. Population confidence-bound evaluation has not yet been implemented.

method.f6affd854eae.source: 查看本历史批次的布局、评分与记录 →
method.f6affd854eae.en: View layouts, scores, and records from this historical batch →

method.29194df38d42.source: 历史原型 · 首批双区域比较

method.cde52e30547c.source: 优化前的首批原型记录

method.9640e5934681.source: 首批采用SimNIBS Ernie体积FEM头模，固定两个区域、每区32点。32次几何构造中完成28组配置，包含26种不同的点位集合。没有运行区域中心或区内坐标的性能优化。
method.9640e5934681.en: The initial batch used the SimNIBS Ernie volumetric FEM head model with two regions and 32 points per region. Of 32 geometric construction attempts, 28 configurations were completed, comprising 26 distinct point sets. No performance optimization of region centers or within-region coordinates was run.

method.b47c2382b41f.source: ① 新电极位置的前向计算
method.b47c2382b41f.en: ① Forward computation at new electrode positions

method.af01ed055d3b.source: 基准为BioSemi64名称匹配的Ernie-SPM12全头模板坐标。571个唯一候选点与64个基准点在同一FEM上直接求解，再分别进行Helmert对比，得到63个参考无关观测维度。候选场在各位置直接求解。
method.af01ed055d3b.en: The reference uses Ernie-SPM12 whole-head template coordinates matched to BioSemi64 channel names. Fields at 571 unique candidate points and 64 reference points are solved directly in the same FEM model. Separate Helmert contrasts yield 63 reference-free observation dimensions. Candidate fields are solved at each actual position.

method.11215429709d.source: ② 固定源先验与物理噪声
method.11215429709d.en: ② Fixed source prior and physical noise

method.03165391e658.source: 使用4,096个皮层法向字典源、皮层面积加权的对角源协方差，偶极矩尺度10 nA·m。0/10/20 dB名义SNR均由全头基准标定；同一档位各布局共享相同通道噪声标准差。
method.03165391e658.en: The model uses 4,096 cortical-normal dictionary sources, a cortical-area-weighted diagonal source covariance, and a dipole-moment scale of 10 nA·m. Nominal SNR values of 0/10/20 dB are calibrated against the whole-head reference. At each setting, all layouts share the same channel-noise standard deviation.

method.c065c315e6ae.source: ③ 信号重建报告绝对解释率与相对比值
method.c065c315e6ae.en: ③ Signal reconstruction reports absolute explained energy and relative ratios

method.2e11ff382443.source: 预测目标z是干净的全头64点参考无关电位场。根据源先验、前向模型和噪声协方差构造LMMSE估计器，解析计算期望重建误差。相对值为候选重建解释率除以同噪声基准重建解释率，保留超过100%的结果。
method.2e11ff382443.en: Prediction target z is the clean, reference-free whole-head field at the 64 reference points. An LMMSE estimator is constructed from the source prior, forward model, and noise covariance, and expected reconstruction error is calculated analytically. The relative value divides the candidate explained-energy score by the reference score at the same noise level; values above 100% are retained.

method.92ef1a24170b.source: 因此基准的相对值恒为100%，而20 dB下基准的绝对解释率为99.31%。结果页同时显示这两个尺度。
method.92ef1a24170b.en: The reference's relative value is therefore always 100%, while its absolute explained-energy score at 20 dB is 99.31%. The results page displays both scales.

method.53c2026465c4.source: ④ 敏感度与定位分别解释
method.53c2026465c4.en: ④ Sensitivity and localization are interpreted separately

method.7b50068323b3.source: 敏感度逐源计算候选与全头基准的最大双极幅度比，按相对保留率排序，取最低10%皮层面积的加权均值，权重按皮层面积分配。定位仅计算30 mm半径上限、6 mm点距的四个预冻结原型及基准，以256个离字典生成源、每源16次噪声，扫描4,096个固定法向候选源；共61,440次模拟试验。
method.7b50068323b3.en: Sensitivity compares the candidate and whole-head reference maximum bipolar amplitudes source by source. Ratios are sorted, and the cortical-area-weighted mean over the lowest 10% of cortical area is calculated. Localization is evaluated only for four prefrozen prototypes with a 30 mm radius limit and 6 mm spacing, plus the reference. It scans 4,096 fixed-normal candidate sources using 256 off-dictionary generation sources and 16 noise realizations per source, totaling 61,440 simulated trials.

method.811991018f53.source: 无噪声基准仍有10.73 mm中位误差和20.57 mm的P90误差，说明离散固定法向字典存在匹配限制。生成与反演共用头模和导电率，离网格设置仍保留同模型偏差；定位结果用于当前反演器的诊断。
method.811991018f53.en: The noiseless reference still has a median error of 10.73 mm and a P90 error of 20.57 mm, indicating matching limitations in the discrete fixed-normal dictionary. Generation and inversion share the head model and conductivity, so off-grid generation retains shared-model bias. Localization results diagnose the current inverse estimator.

method.ead2eaba3f45.source: ⑤ 计算复现与模型近似
method.ead2eaba3f45.en: ⑤ Computational reproducibility and model approximations

method.59792fafe7e6.source: 12项计算检查通过，两个独立进程重复运行的前向和指标NPZ逐字节一致，均基于同一头模。108 / 4,352个源采用最近灰质恢复，其中4个曲面点与血液分割不一致，作为明确的灰质近似模型保留。区域是坐标掩膜裁剪的图路径贴片，点距采用欧氏弦距，连续测地几何与毛发范围审核列入后续计划。
method.59792fafe7e6.en: All 12 computational checks passed. Forward and metric NPZ files from two independent process runs are byte-identical, using the same head model. Nearest-gray-matter recovery was used for 108 / 4,352 sources. Four of these surface points conflict with the blood segmentation and are retained as an explicitly documented gray-matter approximation. Regions are graph-path patches clipped by coordinate masks, and spacing uses Euclidean chord distance. Continuous geodesic geometry and hair-domain review are planned for later stages.

method.db0ffd2c8bdb.source: 首批原型范围为双区域几何布局。1/3/4/6区域、坐标优化和新源复评按后续批次记录；群体阈值与连续最小面积评价列入后续计划。
method.db0ffd2c8bdb.en: The initial prototypes cover two-region geometric layouts. Layouts with 1/3/4/6 regions, coordinate optimization, and new-source reevaluation are recorded in later batches. Population-threshold and continuous minimum-area evaluations remain future work.

method.a0fd625148a0.source: 查看交互曲线、点位与原始数据 →
method.a0fd625148a0.en: View interactive curves, positions, and original data →

method.06f266a4545e.source: 后续验证计划 · 尚未全部实施
method.06f266a4545e.en: Future validation plan · Not yet fully implemented

method.23654d001a3c.source: 以下为理想化几何与群体评价的计划。当前实现见上方“布局计算”和指标说明。
method.23654d001a3c.en: The following plans address idealized geometry and population evaluation. The current implementation is described above under Layout Computation and in the metric guide.

method.b9607710c930.source: 总数固定，优化区域和全部坐标
method.b9607710c930.en: Fix the total count and optimize regions and all coordinates

method.6af9ab08a9cd.source: 总测量电极数固定为64，区域数为1、2、3、4或6。三个区域和六个区域采用平衡整数分配。
method.6af9ab08a9cd.en: The total is fixed at 64 measurement electrodes in 1, 2, 3, 4, or 6 regions. Three- and six-region layouts use balanced integer allocations.

method.0d314c42f8de.source: 计划把每区定义为包含该区全部电极的最小测地圆盘。主尺寸是各区实际半径的最大值；滑块给出共同上限，不强迫所有区域等大。所有点之间必须满足最小测地距离。
method.0d314c42f8de.en: Each region is planned to be the smallest geodesic disk containing all its electrodes. The primary size measure is the largest actual radius across regions. The slider supplies a common upper limit without requiring equal-sized regions. Every pair of points must satisfy a minimum geodesic distance.

method.8e7d4e0f4294.source: 把聚集代价与低毛发约束代价分开
method.8e7d4e0f4294.en: Separate the costs of spatial concentration and low-hair constraints

method.2b16932439e2.en: Free centers over the entire admissible surface

method.d238aeab2017.source: 约束最少的比较族，用于评价限定部位带来的性能变化；搜索结果为当前预算内找到的较优值。
method.d238aeab2017.en: The least constrained comparison family assesses performance changes caused by restricting placement locations. Search results are the better values found within the current budget.

method.6221eb359fb7.source: 电极只能位于耳后、耳周、前额和眶周掩膜。理想等噪声模型中各部位保持相同噪声尺度。
method.6221eb359fb7.en: Electrodes are restricted to postauricular, periauricular, forehead, and periorbital masks. The idealized equal-noise model uses the same noise scale at all locations.

method.55891b854650.source: 直接比较严格双耳后、耳后加前额及双侧完整耳周等可解释原型。
method.55891b854650.en: Directly compare interpretable prototypes such as strictly bilateral postauricular, postauricular-plus-forehead, and full bilateral periauricular layouts.

method.0c2367c9f4b1.source: 三项评价指标分别报告
method.0c2367c9f4b1.en: Report the three evaluation metrics separately

method.5c63271897c6.source: 主指标：64导信号重建保留率

method.10efdd2c15dc.source: 无噪声BioSemi64电位场是重建目标；候选与BioSemi观测均含同一物理尺度的独立噪声。分别计算LMMSE解释率，再取候选/BioSemi比值。绝对值和相对值同时报告。
method.10efdd2c15dc.en: The noiseless BioSemi64 potential field is the reconstruction target. Candidate and BioSemi observations contain independent noise at the same physical scale. LMMSE explained-energy scores are calculated separately, then expressed as a candidate/BioSemi ratio. Absolute and relative values are both reported.

method.36d2b1c4f7fb.en: Sensitivity to cortical-normal sources across the cortex

method.f2d8526bc734.source: 逐源比较最大双极幅度；每头模先取表面积加权的源下10% CVaR，再跨头模取下10% CVaR。结果为两层面积加权下尾指标。
method.f2d8526bc734.en: Compare maximum bipolar amplitudes source by source. First compute the surface-area-weighted lower 10% source CVaR within each head model, then the lower 10% CVaR across head models. This produces a two-level lower-tail metric with source-area weighting.

method.b111997270f2.source: 使用冻结的固定法向单偶极最大似然扫描。相对分数来自0–50 mm定位成功曲线面积；同时报告中位数、p90和p95绝对毫米误差。
method.b111997270f2.en: Use a frozen maximum-likelihood scan for a single dipole with fixed normal orientation. Relative scores are derived from the area under the 0–50 mm localization-success curve. Absolute median, p90, and p95 errors in mm are also reported.

method.9fee8fdb5f5a.source: 置信区间的bootstrap单位是头模型。本项目早期计划以至少100个独立锁定测试头模进行群体置信界评估；样本量与具体执行方案尚待确定。三个约束中的最低LCB称为“三项相对指标的最低置信下限”。
method.9fee8fdb5f5a.en: The bootstrap unit for confidence intervals is the head model. An early plan proposed at least 100 independent, locked test head models for population confidence-bound evaluation; sample size and execution details remain to be determined. The smallest LCB across the three constraints is the Minimum Lower Confidence Bound of the Three Relative Metrics.

method.4c6c03d86fbb.source: 区域半径与性能的权衡曲线
method.4c6c03d86fbb.en: Trade-off curves between region radius and performance

method.2997689e0371.source: 几何不可行性通过严格装填界或完备证明判定；性能不可行性通过严格性能上界判定。有限搜索低于AR时，记录为“预设搜索预算内未找到达标布局”。
method.2997689e0371.en: Geometric infeasibility requires rigorous packing bounds or a complete proof. Performance infeasibility requires a rigorous performance upper bound. A bounded search that does not reach Minimum Required Retention is recorded as No qualifying layout found within the predefined search budget.

method.9c9eede64867.source: 选择包含完整耳后、耳周、前额和眶周的解剖头表面，并核对来源与许可。
method.9c9eede64867.en: Select an anatomical head surface with complete postauricular, periauricular, forehead, and periorbital coverage, and verify its source and license.

method.9c282f1f37a0.source: 在同一坐标系注册BioSemi64、连续候选表面、源空间和低毛发掩膜。
method.9c282f1f37a0.en: Register BioSemi64, the continuous candidate surface, source space, and low-hair masks in the same coordinate frame.

method.b3a3341c27ed.source: 通过初步装填实验确定最小测地点距，并证明每个目标区域能够容纳规定点数。
method.b3a3341c27ed.en: Use preliminary packing experiments to determine minimum geodesic spacing and prove that each target region can accommodate its assigned number of points.

method.7840fc47dfd5.source: 冻结clean target、源协方差、噪声尺度和定位器，再验证参考不变性与网格加密稳定性。
method.7840fc47dfd5.en: Freeze the clean target, source covariance, noise scale, and localizer, then verify reference invariance and stability under mesh refinement.

retention_explainer.be683d26a8c8.en: The numerator is reconstruction mean squared error, and the denominator is total expected target-field energy. Lower reconstruction error gives a higher explained-energy score. E[·] denotes expectation, and E

retention_explainer.73a108ae535e.source: 表示该布局的重建解释率评分。
retention_explainer.73a108ae535e.en: denotes the layout's reconstruction explained-energy score.

retention_explainer.300ff093f00e.en: Noisy observations from the standard 64-channel layout also produce reconstruction error. The ratio of the two explained-energy scores measures relative reconstruction performance.

retention_explainer.1e4b0d9a63d5.source: 三、幅度保留率（最差10%）：哪些脑源的信息损失最严重？
retention_explainer.1e4b0d9a63d5.en: 3. Amplitude retention (worst 10%): which brain sources lose the most information?

retention_explainer.ce38a88f0491.source: 一部分脑源表现较好，会使整体重建指标较高，同时另一部分脑源仍存在较大的损失。幅度保留率（最差10%）专门检查后者。
retention_explainer.ce38a88f0491.en: Good performance for some brain sources can yield a high overall reconstruction score while other sources still suffer substantial losses. Amplitude retention (worst 10%) specifically examines the latter.

retention_explainer.5dd56a274d95.source: 对于同一个脑源q，计算布局能够产生的最大电极间电位差；它也等于所有双极组合中最大的电位差幅度。
retention_explainer.5dd56a274d95.en: For each brain source q, calculate the largest potential difference between electrodes in the layout. This is also the maximum potential-difference amplitude across all bipolar combinations.

retention_explainer.e7b369fbb681.source: 源q的最大双极幅度 AX 等于最大电位减最小电位；逐源比值 rq 等于 AX 除以标准64导幅度 A64
retention_explainer.e7b369fbb681.en: Maximum bipolar amplitude AX for source q equals the maximum potential minus the minimum potential; source-wise ratio rq equals AX divided by standard-64 amplitude A64

retention_explainer.373c9fbd78c8.source: 相对表现最差、合计占10%皮层面积权重的脑源
retention_explainer.373c9fbd78c8.en: the relatively worst-performing brain sources totaling 10% of cortical-area weight

retention_explainer.d19491e61edf.source: 幅度保留率（最差10%）是逐源幅度比按皮层面积加权的最低10%下尾平均
retention_explainer.d19491e61edf.en: Amplitude retention (worst 10%) is the cortical-area-weighted lower 10% tail mean of source-wise amplitude ratios

retention_explainer.001ef84fa142.source: LCVaR表示“下尾平均”。边界处按所需的部分权重计入，使所取皮层面积权重恰好为10%。
retention_explainer.001ef84fa142.en: LCVaR denotes the lower-tail mean. A fractional weight is included at the boundary so the selected cortical-area weight is exactly 10%.

retention_explainer.01f6e57fb49a.source: 它指相比标准64导，当前布局对这些脑源的接收敏感度较弱。示例值

retention_explainer.efd510642b69.source: 表示：对相对表现最差的那部分模拟脑源，该布局的最大双极电位幅度，平均约为标准64导的12.50%。
retention_explainer.efd510642b69.en: means that, for the relatively worst-performing simulated sources, this layout's maximum bipolar potential amplitude averages approximately 12.50% of the standard-64 amplitude.

retention_explainer.ecd2681cb0e2.source: 该指标是尾部源的幅度比均值。尾部内各源仍有差异，单个源的值可以低于均值；全体源表现需结合逐源结果查看。
retention_explainer.ecd2681cb0e2.en: This metric is the mean amplitude ratio for tail sources. Sources within the tail still differ, and individual values can fall below the mean. Source-wise results are needed to assess the full source population.

retention_explainer.fd1cee2b44e4.source: 信号重建57.15%与敏感度12.50%并不矛盾：前者衡量整体期望重建误差，后者检查相对损失最大的尾部脑源。
retention_explainer.fd1cee2b44e4.en: Signal reconstruction of 57.15% and sensitivity of 12.50% are compatible: the former summarizes overall expected reconstruction error, while the latter examines tail sources with the greatest relative losses.

retention_explainer.134554c20225.source: 数值边界：标准64导对某个源的幅度接近零时
retention_explainer.134554c20225.en: Numerical boundary: near-zero standard-64 amplitude for a source

retention_explainer.f8e895ad8b62.source: 实现以数值容差排除接近零的分母，并重新归一化有效源面积权重；排除面积超过0.1%时，指标无法计算。本固定示例未排除任何源。该容差属于本实验的数值处理规则。
retention_explainer.f8e895ad8b62.en: The implementation excludes near-zero denominators using a numerical tolerance and renormalizes the remaining source-area weights. If excluded area exceeds 0.1%, the metric cannot be calculated. No sources were excluded in this fixed example. This tolerance is part of the experiment's numerical rules.

retention_explainer.89c82ac01e63.source: 四、相对定位评分：定位误差如何转换成相对指标？
retention_explainer.89c82ac01e63.en: 4. Relative Localization Utility: how is localization error converted to a relative metric?

retention_explainer.ffe240d13a61.source: 半径约束设计页通过离散源定位仿真计算误差，再换算为相对评分。
retention_explainer.ffe240d13a61.en: The radius-constrained design page calculates errors through discrete source-localization simulations and converts them into relative scores.

retention_explainer.cf453d28420d.source: 本页示例使用256个离开反演字典网格的生成源，每个源16次噪声重复，采用4,096点固定法向反演字典。两套布局使用相同的定位算法与物理噪声标定规则。
retention_explainer.cf453d28420d.en: This example uses 256 generation sources off the inverse-dictionary grid, 16 noise realizations per source, and a 4,096-point fixed-normal inverse dictionary. Both layouts use the same localization algorithm and physical noise-calibration rule.

retention_explainer.20555d305504.source: 定位误差d为估计位置与真实生成位置之间的三维距离，单位毫米
retention_explainer.20555d305504.en: Localization error d is the three-dimensional distance between the estimated and true generation positions, measured in mm

retention_explainer.3788a53017f9.source: 重复次数表示同一头模中不同源与噪声的模拟次数。
retention_explainer.3788a53017f9.en: The repetition count refers to simulated source and noise trials within the same head model.

retention_explainer.224c9832c201.source: 把误差转换为效用评分
retention_explainer.224c9832c201.en: Convert error into a utility score

retention_explainer.2ea888ffcd2e.source: 单次定位评分u等于0与1减去误差除以50毫米两者中的较大值
retention_explainer.2ea888ffcd2e.en: Trial-level localization utility u is the larger of 0 and 1 minus error divided by 50 mm

retention_explainer.7131ae00d417.en: Meaning of the localization score with a 50 mm scale

retention_explainer.ffb26b46b3a2.source: 50 mm是本实验规定的评分尺度。改变这个尺度会改变评分。
retention_explainer.ffb26b46b3a2.en: 50 mm is the scoring scale specified for this experiment. Changing this scale changes the score.

retention_explainer.20021fd49c5a.source: 计算下尾评分并与标准64导比较
retention_explainer.20021fd49c5a.en: Calculate lower-tail utility and compare it with standard 64 channels

retention_explainer.b524a29d12b9.source: 每个脑源先对16次噪声的效用评分求平均。
retention_explainer.b524a29d12b9.en: For each brain source, first average utility over 16 noise realizations.

retention_explainer.57c748b03247.source: 对每套布局分别取表现最差10%源面积权重的平均评分。
retention_explainer.57c748b03247.en: For each layout separately, calculate the weighted mean score over the worst 10% of source-area weight.

retention_explainer.b0cfd34fa527.source: 当前布局评分除以标准64导评分。
retention_explainer.b0cfd34fa527.en: Divide the current layout's score by the standard-64 score.

retention_explainer.676de26eb191.source: 相对定位评分等于当前布局下尾效用UX除以标准64导下尾效用U64
retention_explainer.676de26eb191.en: Relative Localization Utility equals the current layout's lower-tail utility UX divided by the standard-64 lower-tail utility U64

retention_explainer.55d641d49690.source: 两套布局的最差10%不一定包含同一组脑源。
retention_explainer.55d641d49690.en: The worst 10% need not contain the same brain sources in the two layouts.

retention_explainer.22d424c4fdd8.en: Fixed example: 0.09663 divided by 0.52111 is approximately 18.54%

retention_explainer.acdad19f9335.source: 它表示按当前误差评分函数和下尾聚合规则，示例布局的定位评分约为标准64导的18.54%，即相对定位评分为18.54%。更直观的毫米误差如下。
retention_explainer.acdad19f9335.en: Under the specified error-to-utility function and lower-tail aggregation rule, the example layout scores approximately 18.54% of the standard 64-channel layout, giving a Relative Localization Utility of 18.54%. The more directly interpretable errors in mm are shown below.

retention_explainer.ba3919a33aad.source: 固定示例与标准64导的绝对定位误差
retention_explainer.ba3919a33aad.en: Absolute localization errors for the fixed example and standard 64 channels

retention_explainer.dc728bb3d07b.source: 90分位数表示约90%的模拟试验误差不超过该数值。此处误差分位数按模拟试验汇总，下尾评分另按皮层面积加权。
retention_explainer.dc728bb3d07b.en: The 90th percentile means approximately 90% of simulated trial errors are no greater than that value. Error quantiles here are summarized over simulated trials; lower-tail utility is separately weighted by cortical area.

retention_explainer.2d8fb910601a.source: 相对评分比较经过换算后的定位表现；毫米误差直接描述空间偏差，两者同时报告。
retention_explainer.2d8fb910601a.en: Relative scores compare transformed localization performance, while errors in mm directly describe spatial deviation. Both are reported.

retention_explainer.39c2bc0f2821.source: 五、最低值G和接受阈值AR如何使用？
retention_explainer.39c2bc0f2821.en: 5. How are the minimum G and Minimum Required Retention used?

retention_explainer.7425e909904f.source: 通过当且仅当信号重建、幅度保留率（最差10%）、相对定位评分三项都不低于AR
retention_explainer.7425e909904f.en: A layout passes if and only if Field Reconstruction Retention, amplitude retention (worst 10%), and Relative Localization Utility all meet Minimum Required Retention

retention_explainer.0dfce3bd6f4e.en: G is a shorthand for this rule:

retention_explainer.54cd0ac7da97.source: G是三个相对指标的最低值，通过条件是G不低于AR
retention_explainer.54cd0ac7da97.en: G is the minimum of the three relative metrics; passing requires G to meet Minimum Required Retention

retention_explainer.7f04f838b692.en: In the fixed example, G is the minimum of 57.15%, 12.50%, and 18.54%, which is 12.50%

retention_explainer.4169ab219722.source: 固定示例在不同AR下的共同通过判断
retention_explainer.4169ab219722.en: Joint pass decisions for the fixed example at different Minimum Required Retention settings

retention_explainer.71bb37b68597.source: 示例布局是否通过三项共同约束
retention_explainer.71bb37b68597.en: Does the example layout meet all three constraints?

retention_explainer.07dd1838de3b.source: 不通过，虽然信号重建已超过50%
retention_explainer.07dd1838de3b.en: Does not pass, although signal reconstruction exceeds 50%

retention_explainer.fb08e5366b75.source: 通过当前模型的点估计判据
retention_explainer.fb08e5366b75.en: Passes the current model's point-estimate criterion

retention_explainer.eba0fc685910.source: 判断使用未四舍五入的数值。页面显示的小数只是便于阅读。
retention_explainer.eba0fc685910.en: Decisions use unrounded values. Displayed decimals are rounded only for readability.

retention_explainer.75f84458df01.source: G＝12.50%表示三项指标中的最低值为12.50%。
retention_explainer.75f84458df01.en: G = 12.50% means the lowest of the three metrics is 12.50%.

retention_explainer.18627d503550.source: 重建解释率、电位差幅度和定位评分分别评价不同能力；统一阈值用于三项联合达标判定。
retention_explainer.18627d503550.en: Reconstruction explained energy, potential-difference amplitude, and localization score assess different capabilities. A common threshold is used for their joint pass decision.

retention_explainer.955843edc812.source: AR判定针对聚合后的三项指标，个别脑源可低于阈值。当前搜索优化信号重建与敏感度中的较低值，定位在冻结布局后评价。人体与跨头模表现属于后续验证。
retention_explainer.955843edc812.en: Minimum Required Retention applies to the three aggregated metrics; individual brain sources can fall below the threshold. The current search optimizes the lower of signal reconstruction and sensitivity, with localization evaluated after the layout is frozen. Human and cross-head-model performance require later validation.

retention_explainer.3b7e17433b39.source: 修改AR为什么不需要重新计算？
retention_explainer.3b7e17433b39.en: Why does changing Minimum Required Retention not require recomputation?

retention_explainer.cd5992621241.source: AR只改变通过判断，不改变电极位置、区域大小、前向模型、噪声或已有指标，因此直接使用已有结果。修改区域、半径或布局后，必须查找该配置的匹配结果；没有匹配结果时需要重新计算。
retention_explainer.cd5992621241.en: Minimum Required Retention changes only the pass decision, leaving electrode positions, region sizes, the forward model, noise, and existing metrics unchanged. Existing results can therefore be reused directly. Changing regions, radius, or layout requires results matching the new configuration; computation is needed if no match exists.

retention_explainer.2276c06038f7.source: 六、几何有解与性能达标是两件事
retention_explainer.2276c06038f7.en: 6. Geometric feasibility and performance qualification are separate

retention_explainer.893c55ef2cb4.source: App先构造满足约束的64点布局，再评价性能。几何可行表示：
retention_explainer.893c55ef2cb4.en: The app first constructs a 64-point layout satisfying the constraints, then evaluates performance. Geometric feasibility means:

retention_explainer.73e82e9d9c82.source: 有64个不同的测量点，且每区分配符合要求；
retention_explainer.73e82e9d9c82.en: There are 64 distinct measurement points with the required allocation in each region;

retention_explainer.f366879d8024.source: 点距达到下限，电极位于允许区域及半径范围内；
retention_explainer.f366879d8024.en: Point spacing meets the minimum, and electrodes lie within the allowed regions and radius limits;

retention_explainer.182178a3fe27.source: 区域满足规定的分离要求。
retention_explainer.182178a3fe27.en: Regions satisfy the specified separation requirements.

retention_explainer.e71bb3f76e74.source: 性能达标表示所要求的指标达到AR。
retention_explainer.e71bb3f76e74.en: Performance qualifies when the required metrics meet Minimum Required Retention.

retention_explainer.d313b0038164.source: 几何构造和性能评价是两个独立步骤。
retention_explainer.d313b0038164.en: Geometric construction and performance evaluation are separate steps.

retention_explainer.c004286bc47d.source: 搜索未找到布局时，记录本轮搜索状态；整体几何可行性仍待判定。
retention_explainer.c004286bc47d.en: If no layout is found, the search outcome is recorded; overall geometric feasibility remains undetermined.

retention_explainer.a724f3185cdd.source: 当前半径是ROI约束下的头表面网格边图路径上限，是连续表面距离的离散近似；面积使用原生顶点面积积分。几何定义和搜索预算应与结果一同解释。
retention_explainer.a724f3185cdd.en: The current radius is an upper bound on ROI-constrained paths along the head-surface mesh-edge graph, a discrete approximation to continuous surface distance. Area uses integration over native vertices. Interpret results together with these geometric definitions and the search budget.

retention_explainer.5d45f8cb4f47.source: 七、这些结果适用于什么范围？
retention_explainer.5d45f8cb4f47.en: 7. What is the scope of these results?

retention_explainer.1f2f57f273bc.en: A single Ernie head model with the specified cortical-normal sources and source weights;

retention_explainer.1dd110d1c440.en: Placement domains are approximated using model coordinates; skin and hair distributions still require anatomical review. Generation and inversion share the head model and forward method, so off-dictionary sources retain shared-model bias. Layouts use a finite grid search, and global optimality has not been verified.

retention_explainer.152d9d0dad3d.source: AR是用户设定的相对性能接受阈值。界面显示90%时，公式中对应0.90。当前设计页要求三项指标分别达到AR。

retention_explainer.152d9d0dad3d.zh: 最低保留要求由用户设定，表示相对性能必须达到的下限，公式中记为τ。界面显示90%时，对应τ＝0.90。当前设计页要求三项指标分别达到这一要求。

fixes.0ba20edd5d31.en: Minimum required retention is the design requirement; the three relative metrics describe reconstruction, amplitude, and localization utility.
